study.question: Can reducing only advertisement-ID table capacity, while retaining the strongest joint model's16-wide interface and every other field, preserve click AUC and reduce measured prediction cost? Does a trainable shared lift rescue a compact table, and does the retained coordinate choice explain its outcome?
study.hypothesis: Observation: accepted native96 has31,993,779 Parameters, including31,793,216 embedding Parameters (99.3731%) and200,563 dense Parameters. Same-seed native controls repeatedly reproduce click AUC0.6675003890552496; they are reproducibility checks, not independent seed support. In g2-r0066, replacing factors with a dense fresh product saved7,680 Parameters but reduced AUC by0.0002674221 at rank96 and0.0002867692 at rank88; model-only p50 did not decrease (native96 15.103ms versus dense96 15.274ms). This rejects that implementation's utility in that screen, not all factorized capacity mechanisms. Earlier all-field width12 lost0.0026423626 AUC versus the original joint entry, but also changed all readout dimensions and initialization draws. It does not identify item_id marginal utility at the stronger current parent. Other trajectories include numerically preserving coefficient dead-code removal (g2-r0046-joint_coefficient_extension) and tower batching (g2-r0035-joint_batch_both); their modest/no clear latency benefit cautions against equating fewer operations with measured speed. Mechanism hypothesis, unverified: advertisement-ID vectors may occupy a useful12-dimensional shared subspace even when other fields still need16 dimensions. Replace only its V-by16 table with a V-by12 table and a shared16-by12 linear lift; IDs, vocabulary rows, target/history sharing and all dense outer dimensions remain unchanged. The learned lift may adapt a shared orientation lost by fixed coordinate injection. Sparsity/memory traffic savings may or may not outweigh the added lift GEMM and unchanged outer computation. This is established factorized representation machinery, with no originality or external-effectiveness claim. Before screening freeze the only selection-eligible candidate as id12_learned. Require validation click AUC >= 0.6673003890552496, i.e. loss at most0.0002 against the contemporaneous native96 reference AND the frozen original joint entry. Historical values native96=0.6675003890552496, entry=0.6667535475261670; use the stricter current-reference floor, not retrospective relaxation. Require strictly fewer total trainable Parameters AND measured model-only p50 at least2% lower, p95 no more than2% higher, and full-validation inference wall at least2% lower under identical hardware, inputs, batch, precision and loading. Report training wall/allocated GPU seconds, peak memory, throughput and all four AUC/Logloss separately. A parameter saving alone is not a prediction-cost result. Timing requires repeat/interleaving through a host-owned interface if exposed; a single pass can only support a provisional screen. Fixed/spread controls are attribution-only, never promoted after seeing outcomes. No hidden test call; freeze a final comparison suite in a later authorized phase before any withheld assessment.

study.proposed_difference: One bounded allocation change: retain12 coordinates of the fresh item_id table and inject them into16 output coordinates using a16x12 lift. Primary candidate learns the lift; the fixed-lift control has identical initial table/lift and executes the same affine; a learned spread-coordinate control uses floor(16*j/12), j=0..11, instead of prefix0..11 at exactly the same count and operators. The full original table is discarded before host optimizer construction. Only the primary candidate is utility-eligible. Added BF16 affine rounding, reduced initial per-ID energy and host-global dense clipping are explicit confounds, not concealed as pure rank effects.

For item vocabulary sizeV reported by the actual read-only FeatureMap, learned compact storage is31,993,779 -4V +192 total trainable Parameters; embedding storage31,793,216 -4V, dense storage200,755. The fixed lift has total31,993,779 -4V, dense200,563 and an additional192-element nontrainable buffer. Both have total allocated table+lift scalars reduced by4V-192. Host counts and storage, not arithmetic, are authoritative. V is not available locally; no per-field count or speedup is invented.

At construction the two prefix compact variants have identical lookup/lift values and outputs. In FP32 they reproduce the native item_id embedding after zeroing the four omitted coordinates (within explicit reference tolerance); other initialized state and external RNG remain unchanged. Standard BF16 autocast on the new affine may introduce rounding absent in raw lookups; measure it separately.

If learnable shared orientation helps beyond compact-table learning, id12_learned should beat id12_fixed in click AUC and/or relevant history slices after matched scratch training, with its192 extra dense coefficients and changed clipping contribution explicitly counted. This is local controlled support, not an isolated proof of optimal subspace learning.

If coordinate retention dominates, id12_spread will differ materially despite exactly matched parameters, operator shapes and table value distribution. Similar outcomes from both choices weaken that alternative but do not substitute for paired independent seeds.

If table bandwidth or working-set size matters, actual inference time and memory should decrease despite the added12-to16 lift over101 positions per sample. Otherwise the utility prediction fails even if quality and Parameter count pass. All auxiliary task deterioration and history-slice counts must be retained.
falsifiers: Failure of any native reproduction, finite forward/backward, information/mask boundary, optimizer-ownership or compact-storage prerequisite invalidates the affected comparison; it is execution/integrity failure, not evidence against the mechanism.

Candidate click AUC below the frozen preservation floor, or no reproducible measured prediction-cost reduction, rejects this candidate's utility under this protocol. Do not select an attribution control or relax thresholds in response.

No advantage over the fixed-lift control limits the adaptive-shared-orientation explanation; improvement can instead come from table learning, capacity regularization or added dense coefficients. Large prefix/spread disagreement limits any basis-independent capacity conclusion.

Reproducible AUC loss across both coordinate choices bounds this12-dimensional ID implementation; it does not establish that every field needs16 dimensions or that all ID compression fails. A successful run alone establishes neither a new mechanism nor general transfer beyond this offline benchmark.
alternative_explanations: New lift GEMM/casts and unchanged16-wide downstream compute may erase sparse lookup savings; data loading, hardware state and timing noise may explain single-pass cost differences.

Zero-injection initialization removes four coordinate energies and directions as well as rank. Prefix versus spread controls coordinate choice, not energy restoration or the full alternative space; latter controls require a subsequent predeclared study if consequential.

An added affine introduces BF16 rounding absent in raw FP32 embeddings. Fixed and learned controls share this numerical path, but native-versus-compact differences cannot be assigned solely to capacity.

Learned lift adds192 dense coefficients and a dense gradient that participates in global host clipping. The fixed-lift comparison is nearly parameter matched, not exactly capacity/optimizer matched; record counts and gradient/clipping diagnostics only if the host exposes them.

All auxiliary tasks share target/history ID tables, but their item/scorer gradients remain blocked. Changing ID representation alters their forward distributions and can change dense clipping/later shared learning without adding direct auxiliary item gradients.

Current evidence uses a single frozen training seed and repeatedly selected validation. Different initializations, validation selection bias, frequency support and inherited offline auxiliary-label timing can explain apparent gains. No personal knowledge or withheld outcomes are available.
